performance.verdict: Meta working; Google burning $1,982 with unverified attribution and 5 overdue milestones blocking real scale.

findings.text: 5 SOW milestones overdue since Jul 31–Aug 1: Pre-Launch Stack Test, LSA Verification, Site/Landing Pages, Ads Launch, and Meta Retargeting — all unconfirmed complete.
Google Ads spent $1,982.22 in 28 days yielding 7 conversions (pixel-sourced, client-side), implying $283 CPL vs Meta's $41.87 — Google efficiency is unconfirmed, not proven.
Meta delivered all 17 platform-reported leads at $41.87 effective CPL on $711.69 spend; 3-day signal (Sep 10–12: 4+3+2 leads) vs prior 3 days (Sep 7–9: 1+2+1 leads) confirms upward trend.
GHL shows 70 opportunities created against 17 platform leads and 0 appointments booked — 53-opportunity gap suggests intake leak or duplicate contact creation, not ad underperformance.
GBP actions dropped 57.14% week-over-week to 0 actions on Sep 9–12 (4 consecutive zero days), diverging from paid lead growth — possible profile suppression or data gap.

suggestions.text: Audit GHL pipeline: reconcile 70 opportunities vs 17 Meta leads; identify duplicate or mis-routed contact creation immediately.
suggestions.monday_update: GHL shows 70 opportunities created against only 17 platform-reported Meta leads over the 28-day window — a 53-opportunity discrepancy. The fix team should audit GHL contact creation logic to identify duplicate records, mis-routed sources, or contacts imported outside the ad funnel. Success is confirmed when the opportunity count reconciles within ±5 of platform leads and 0 appointments booked rises above zero. Complete audit by 2026-09-17.

suggestions.text: Shift ~$15/day from Google Search to Meta while Google pixel attribution remains unverified; cap Google at LSA-only spend.
suggestions.monday_update: Google Ads spent $1,982.22 in 28 days with 7 conversions via an unverified client-side pixel, implying a probable $283 CPL versus Meta's confirmed $41.87 CPL. Reduce Google Search daily budget by ~$15/day and apply it to the Meta campaign that delivered all 17 leads. Do not touch LSA spend. Success check: Meta CPL remains at or below $60 after 7 days (by 2026-09-20); if it rises above $80, reverse the shift.

suggestions.text: Watch GBP: 4 consecutive zero-action days (Sep 9–12) — re-check Sep 17 before attributing cause.
suggestions.monday_update: GBP actions fell 57.14% week-over-week and logged zero actions on Sep 9–12, four consecutive days, while paid leads grew. This is hypothesis-grade — it may reflect a profile suppression, a data pull issue, or genuine organic drop-off. No action taken this cycle. Re-check on 2026-09-17; if zero-action streak continues past 7 days, escalate to a GBP profile audit.
